app.title: Narok combat laboratory
app.scope: This laboratory observes combat only. Loot, wallet, inventory, attribute allocation and away reports are not part of this build.

playback.note: Pause freezes the laboratory playback clock. It is not an offline cap and it does not settle anything.

controls.placementHelp: Select a character, then choose a cell in the party rows by click or by arrow keys and Enter.
controls.ruleOrderHelp: Rules are scanned in order; the first one whose condition holds is cast.
controls.startHelp: Starting hands the current setup to a new experiment. The previous run is retained as comparison A.
controls.applyNote: Editing here changes the next experiment. A run already in flight keeps the setup it started with.
controls.formationHint: The party re-forms on these cells at the start of every encounter.
controls.fallbackNote: when no rule above can be cast

validation.seedRange: Seed must be an integer between 1 and 4,294,967,295.
validation.unknownPlacement: Every roster member needs a placement.
validation.duplicatePlacement: Two members cannot share a cell.
validation.invalidCell: That cell is outside the party zone.
validation.restRange: Rest HP must be 0-89% and rest MP must be 0-79%.
validation.ruleThreshold: That threshold is outside its allowed range.
validation.unknownTargetParty: That character is no longer in the roster.

condition.ally-targeted: Cast when an enemy is attacking an ally
condition.ally-hp-below: Cast when an ally's HP is below
condition.ally-dead: Cast when an ally has fallen
condition.targets-at-least: Cast when it would hit at least

stopReason.potion-floor: HP potions fell below the floor

error.title: The experiment reported an error
error.WRONG_VERSION: That snapshot was made by a different simulation version.
error.TIME_REWIND: The requested time is earlier than the time already simulated.
error.UNSAFE_INTEGER: A value left the safe integer range.
error.LOOP_DETECTED: The simulation detected a non-progressing loop.
error.STALE_GENERATION: That response belonged to an experiment that is no longer running.
error.PROTOCOL: The worker broke its message contract.

board.empty: No experiment is loaded. Start one to populate the board.

inspect.hint: Automatic combat. Select a skill to inspect why it is waiting; inspecting never casts it.
inspect.heading: {{skill}} — {{state}}
inspect.ready: Off cooldown with enough MP. The strategy decides when it is cast.
inspect.active: Committed: this skill's cast is floored to 1 ms, so it resolves a millisecond from now and there is no cast bar to show.
inspect.casting: A cast is in flight and will resolve when it completes.
inspect.passive: A passive is always in effect and is never cast.

revive.apple: {{actor}} is revived by Idun's Apple with {{amount}} HP.

phase.walking: The party walks towards the next encounter.

event.dropLost: A drop was lost: the bag is full.

stop.wipe: The hunt stopped: the party was wiped out.
stop.stalemate: The experiment stopped: the encounter reached its time limit.
stop.operator: The experiment was stopped by the operator.

comparison.heading: Retained comparisons
comparison.empty: No run retained in this slot yet. Stop or finish an experiment to fill it.
comparison.windowNone: No simulated time elapsed, so no rate can be measured.

export.label: Session export
export.hint: Downloads a JSON file with the setup, the event log and both comparison runs.

hunt.idleHelp: Start a hunt with your party and the selected strategy preset.
hunt.runningHelp: Stop returns the party to town and abandons the current encounter.

stoppedHelp.operator: You stopped the hunt. The encounter in progress was abandoned, the return to town took travel time, and the whole party arrived fully healed.
stoppedHelp.wipe: The whole party fell. It was returned to town, and the town fully healed everyone.
stoppedHelp.stalemate: The encounter reached a stalemate: neither side could defeat the other. The party returned to town and arrived fully healed.
stoppedHelp.retreat: The party retreated from its encounter and returned to town, where it arrived fully healed.
stoppedHelp.potion-floor: Health potions fell below the set minimum, so the party returned to town and arrived fully healed.
stoppedHelp.unknown: The hunt has stopped. The party is in town, fully healed.

hunt.faultedHelp: The hunt is faulted. It needs an explicit recovery before a new hunt can start.
hunt.unavailable: A hunt needs a character, a strategy preset and a loot preset on this account.

serverError.title: The server refused that
serverError.VALIDATION: The server rejected that request as malformed.
serverError.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password do not match.
serverError.FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN: That request came from an origin the server does not accept.
serverError.NOT_OWNED: That does not belong to your account.
serverError.CONFLICT_STATE_VERSION: Your account changed after this was read, so nothing was applied.
serverError.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: That request was already sent with different contents.
serverError.CONTENT_VERSION_MISMATCH: The game content was updated. Reload to continue.
serverError.HUNT_FAULTED: The hunt is faulted and needs an explicit recovery.
serverError.RULE_VIOLATION: That is not allowed right now.
serverError.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
serverError.STALE_GENERATION: That message belonged to a hunt state that is no longer current.
serverError.PROTOCOL: The connection broke its message contract.
serverError.BACKPRESSURE: The connection fell behind and was reset.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.subtitle: your saved presets
strategy.pending: Pending: {{name}} v{{version}}, takes effect at the next encounter
strategy.applyNote: Editing a draft. Save stores this preset; Apply saves and queues it for the next encounter. This fight keeps its current rules.
strategy.conflictHelp: Your draft is still here. Save or apply again against the current version.
strategy.presetConflictHelp: This preset was saved elsewhere since you opened it. Your draft is still here: save again to replace that version, or revert to load it.
strategy.noPresets: No strategy preset is saved on this account.
strategy.savedNote: {{name}} saved as v{{version}}. Hunt rules unchanged. Apply when ready.
strategy.queuedNote: {{name}} v{{version}} saved and queued. It takes effect at the next encounter; the current fight keeps its rules.
strategy.revertedNote: Restored the last saved preset. Current hunt rules unchanged.
strategy.noHunt: No hunt is running, so there is no encounter to apply it to.

bag.title: Bag
bag.noSelection: Select an item to inspect it.

block.unknown: This item is not in the loaded content

filter.title: Loot filter
filter.precedence: Protection first: locked items are never sold in bulk and Legendary drops are always kept. Then exceptions, first match wins; rarity rules last.
filter.previewOver_one: to the {{count}} item in your bag
filter.previewOver_other: to the {{count}} items in your bag
filter.previewOnly: Preview only · bag items stay untouched
filter.cannotApplyDraft: Edited rules are not saved, so they cannot be applied. Revert to apply the saved filter.
filter.noHunt: Applies to a running hunt’s future drops

character.title: Character
character.raiseRefused: Raise {{attr}}, costs {{cost}} points, not enough points
character.choose: Choose + to stage a point. Nothing is spent until you apply.
character.insufficient: Pending {{pending}} is more than the {{unspent}} unspent points. Reset before applying.
character.stale: Your account changed before this was applied, so nothing was spent. Your draft is kept and checked against the new state.
character.skillChoose: Select + to stage a skill rank.
character.nextSkillPoint: Next skill point at level {{level}}. Skill points are always spent by hand.
character.noNextSkillPoint: No further skill point comes with a level.

away.title: While you were away
away.running: Your hunt is still running. Earned rewards are credited.
away.capped: Accrual stopped at the offline limit. The hunt did not stop, and earned rewards are credited.
away.bagFull: The bag filled while you were away. New kept drops were lost; auto-sales, EXP and gold continued.

stopped.wipe: The whole party fell. The hunt ended and the party was returned to town, fully healed.
stopped.stalemate: An encounter ran out of time, so the hunt ended and the party returned to town.
stopped.operator: The hunt was stopped and the party returned to town.
stopped.retreat: The party retreated to town and the hunt ended.
stopped.potion-floor: HP potions fell below the floor, so the hunt ended and the party returned to town.

away.capMeter: Simulated time against the offline limit

loot.title: Loot
loot.lost_one: {{count}} kept drop lost to the full bag
loot.lost_other: {{count}} kept drops lost to the full bag

note.full: Bag {{used}} / {{capacity}}. Make room for future drops; the {{lost}} lost drops cannot be recovered.
note.room: Bag {{used}} / {{capacity}}: there is room for new drops.

away.credited: Rewards were credited when the hunt settled. Opening this report credits nothing.
